name: OKC_TERMS_TEMPLATES_ALL
description: OKC_TERMS_TEMPLATES_ALL stores the all contract templates and its related information. This has geneal information like Name, Start Date, End Date, Intent

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Contract Template. Primary key column for the template table

columns.name: DISABLE_AUTO_HTML_PREVIEW_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the HTML preview should be generated automatically or not. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the template.Possible values are STRUCTURED and CONTRACT_FORM.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Contract Template.

columns.name: INTENT
columns.description: Intent of the Contract Template. Possible values are B Buy or S Sell

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the Contract Template . Possible values are DRAFT, APPROVED, ON HOLD, PENDING_APPROVAL, REJECTED and REVISION

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the Contract Template is available for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date after which the Contract Template can no longer be used.

columns.name: GLOBAL_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if the Contract template is Global or not. Possible values are Y and N.

columns.name: INSTRUCTION_TEXT
columns.description: Instructions to use the Contract Template.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the Contract Template.

columns.name: WORKING_COPY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the Contract Template is a Working copy or not. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: PARENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the original Contract Template if the current template is a working copy. Refers to the TEMPLATE_ID in OKC_TERMS_TEMPLATES_ALL

columns.name: CONTRACT_EXPERT_ENABLED
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether contract expert can be used once the Contract Template is applied on a business document or not. Possible values are Y and N. For Future Use.

columns.name: TMPL_NUMBERING_SCHEME
columns.description: Numbering scheme used on the Contract Template. Refers to the NUMBERING_SCHEME_ID in OKC_NUM_SCHEMES_B

columns.name: PRINT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Print Layout Template used. Refers to the TEMPLATE_ID in XDO_TEMPLATES_B

columns.name: APPROVAL_WF_KEY
columns.description: Approval work flow key

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: Original system reference code

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Original system reference id

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Original system reference id

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: HIDE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the Contract Template should be hidden from the Contract Terms Library or not. Possible values are Y and N.
